key_impacts: Storm surge flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide in New York City.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two New Jersey refineries (Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway in Linden) were shut down, reducing 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD operating capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to outages.
evidence_snippets: Sandy’s arrival on the evening of October 29 coincided with high tide, driving a massive surge in New York Harbor.
Two refineries in Port Reading and Linden, New Jersey, were shut down; 26.3% of operating capacity lost.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn had to evacuate all patients due to the outage.
